title: Prediction Journal Resolution Lag
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:journal topic_name=* forecast_epoch=* resolved_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((resolved_epoch-forecast_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by topic_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures resolution lag by topic for prediction journal entries.
value: Lag tracking shows which topic create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside prediction journal entries.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `resolution lag` on `forecast:journal` events and aggregate them by `topic_name`.
visualization: Table of topic with average and worst resolution lag.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how long things take for each topic so you can see where prediction journal entries slows down.
